{'text': 'Apple TV 目前有一系列新劇集正在播出，陣容相當豐富，緊接著又要再添一部新作。《Small Prophets》是一套英國喜劇，將於下週首播，在爛番茄網保持 100% 的新鮮度。以下是預告片。', 'source': "[0] Apple TV currently has a number of new shows on the air with a deep bench, and another is right around the corner. Small Prophets is a British comedy that premieres next week, and it's got a 100% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Here's the trailer."}

{'text': '《Small Prophets》將於 10 月 7 日在 Apple TV 首播，開播前已獲得觀眾和評論員一致好評', 'source': '[1] Small Prophets premieres on Apple TV on October 7, and it already has a perfect score from viewers and critics alike.'}

{'text': '上個月，Apple TV 宣佈做了一件相當罕見的事：向其他電視台購入現有劇集的播映權。', 'source': '[2] Last month, Apple TV did something fairly rare: it bought the rights to air an existing show from another network.'}

{'text': '英國喜劇《Small Prophets》今年較早時已在英國首播，並在 BBC 大受歡迎，在爛番茄網獲得 100% 好評。Apple 將會將這套備受喜愛的劇集帶給全球觀眾。', 'source': '[3] The British comedy Small Prophets premiered earlier this year in the UK, where it was a hit on the BBC, and earned a perfect 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes. Apple will bring the beloved show to a global audience.'}

{'text': '《Small Prophets》將於 10 月 7 日（星期三）在 Apple TV 首播頭兩集，其後每週更新一集，直至 11 月 4 日。', 'source': '[4] Small Prophets premieres its first two episodes on Apple TV on October 7 (Wednesday), and then one new episode per week until November 4.'}

{'text': 'Apple 今日發佈了《Small Prophets》的預告片，讓大家先睹為快。以下是劇集簡介，隨後是預告片：', 'source': "[5] Apple released the trailer for Small Prophets today, and here's a first look. Here's the show's description, followed by the trailer:"}

{'text': '《Small Prophets》由 Mackenzie Crook 創作、編劇及執導，他亦是《Detectorists》的創作人，並曾演出《The Office》（英國版）和《Pirates of the Caribbean》。', 'source': '[6] Small Prophets is created, written, and directed by Mackenzie Crook, who also created Detectorists and starred in The Office (UK) and Pirates of the Caribbean.'}

{'text': '註：《Small Prophets》將在全球 Apple TV 上架，但英國觀眾要等到 2027 年才看得到。', 'source': "[7] Note: Small Prophets will be available globally on Apple TV, but UK viewers won't get it until 2027."}

{'text': 'Apple TV 目前播出中的喜劇包括麥迪文（Matthew McConaughey）主演的《Brothers》，以及《Ted Lasso》第四季。Owen Wilson 主演的人氣劇《Stick》亦快將回歸。', 'source': '[8] Other comedies currently airing on Apple TV include Brothers, starring Matthew McConaughey, and season 4 of Ted Lasso. The hit Owen Wilson series Stick is also returning soon.'}

{'text': 'Apple TV 月費為 14.99 美元，亦可以透過 Apple One 組合優惠享有折扣價。', 'source': '[9] Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, but you can get a discount through the Apple One bundle.'}
